name: Cactus Apple
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Cactus Apples offer orcs a rare source of moisture in Durotar's dry heat.

sections.title: Desert Harvest
sections.body: Cactus apples grow in clusters around the thick cactuses scattered across the Valley of Trials. Gathering them means working among the thorns, but the fruit gives welcome hydration in Durotar's heat. Galgar, an orc in the valley, gathers the apples to make Cactus Apple Surprise, a cooling treat for recruits enduring their early training.

faq.answer: Cactus apples grow wild in the Valley of Trials in southern Durotar, near the bases of stout cactus plants scattered across the basin.
Cactus Apple Surprise is a chilled dish Galgar prepares with freshly gathered cactus apples, offering relief from Durotar's desert heat.
Galgar, an orc in the Valley of Trials, asks young recruits to bring back six fresh apples in exchange for portions of his cooling dessert.

angles.text: As a wilderness cook in Durotar, you can turn desert cactuses into a hydrating meal.
As a young orc in Durotar, you learn to make use of every scarce bit of moisture the red canyon offers.
